name: JR-8 series maintenance droid
description: JR-8 series maintenance droids were all-purpose janitor units constructed to clean, refurbish, and perform light repairs. They were equipped with an internal cleaning fluid reservoir and integrated spray nozzle, and they were known to spray detergent at individuals who interfered with their tasks.
